scientific_limitations: Real phase-only local analysis at odd-characteristic nondegenerate homogeneous quadratic chirps.
No global perfect-sequence classification, no arbitrary simultaneous integration of Hessian-null directions, and no even-characteristic extension.
The stability neighborhood is existential; no claimed globally sharp radius.
An equivalent differential-defect formulation in older generalized-bent or circulant-Hadamard literature cannot be excluded.
title: Quadratic chirp phase Hessians over odd finite vector spaces
